[.tooling/components/apis/rating-service/docs/architecture.md#11-purpose]

### 1.1 Purpose

The Rating Service API provides a centralized feedback and quality measurement system for AI-powered services within the Enterprise Architecture Platform (EAP). It captures user satisfaction data through structured ratings and qualitative feedback, enabling data-driven continuous improvement.
page_texts.6:
[.tooling/components/apis/rating-service/docs/architecture.md#12-key-capabilities]

### 1.2 Key Capabilities

- **User Feedback Collection**: 5-star rating system with optional comments
- **Multi-Service Support**: Handles ratings for ARIA search and AI Governance reviews
- **Analytics Engine**: Aggregated statistics, trends, and quality metrics
- **Context Preservation**: Full conversation tracking for quality analysis
- **User Attribution**: Supports both authenticated and anonymous feedback

### 3.3 High-Level Architecture Principles

| Principle | Implementation |
|-----------|----------------|
| **Separation of Concerns** | Layered architecture: API → Business Logic → Data Access |
| **Single Responsibility** | Each module has one clear purpose |
| **Dependency Inversion** | Dependencies point inward toward domain |
| **Open/Closed** | Open for extension, closed for modification |
| **Interface Segregation** | Small, focused interfaces |
| **DRY** | Reusable components and utilities |

[.tooling/components/apis/rating-service/docs/architecture.md#61-integration-patterns]

### 6.1 Integration Patterns

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Client as ARIA UI
    participant OAuth as OAuth2 Proxy
    participant API as Rating Service
    participant DB as PostgreSQL
    participant Cache as Redis

    Client->>OAuth: GET /api/rating/v1/aria
    OAuth->>OAuth: Validate Token
    OAuth->>API: Forward with User Context

    API->>Cache: Check Cache
    alt Cache Hit
        Cache-->>API: Return Cached Data
        API-->>Client: 200 OK + Data
    else Cache Miss
        API->>DB: Query Ratings
        DB-->>API: Return Results
        API->>Cache: Store in Cache (5 min TTL)
        API-->>Client: 200 OK + Data
    end
```
